name: Sample Diner
tagline: Breakfast and lunch, made fresh every morning
description: Sample Diner is a friendly neighbourhood restaurant serving breakfast and lunch in Sampleville. Come in for eggs, pancakes, burgers and good coffee.

highlights.title: Breakfast all day
highlights.text: Eggs, pancakes and hash browns, served until we close.

highlights.title: Fresh and local
highlights.text: We buy from farms nearby whenever we can.

highlights.title: Family friendly
highlights.text: High chairs, a kids menu and plenty of crayons.
